trip.trip_notes: Specifically, I have these requirements: some classic new york siteseeing and resturants

plans.trip_plan: Walk through Central Park and see key landmarks like Bethesda Terrace and Bow Bridge.
plans.plan_location: Central Park, Midtown/Upper East & West Side, New York
plans.plan_details: Start from your hotel by subway or taxi to Central Park South entrance.

plans.trip_plan: Visit the American Museum of Natural History and its famous dinosaur and space exhibits.
plans.plan_location: American Museum of Natural History, Upper West Side, New York
plans.plan_details: Walk or take a short crosstown bus or subway along Central Park West.

plans.trip_plan: Enjoy a classic New York deli lunch with sandwiches and matzo ball soup.
plans.plan_location: Katz's Delicatessen, Lower East Side, New York
plans.plan_details: Take the subway downtown to the Lower East Side.

plans.trip_plan: See the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island on a harbor ferry visit.
plans.plan_location: Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island via Battery Park, Lower Manhattan, New York
plans.plan_details: Take the subway to Bowling Green or South Ferry, then walk to Battery Park for the ferry.

plans.trip_plan: Have a classic New York steak or seafood dinner near Times Square, then stroll to see the lights.
plans.plan_location: Gallagher's Steakhouse, Theater District, New York
plans.plan_details: Ride the subway uptown to Times Square and walk to the restaurant, then explore the area on foot.

plans.trip_plan: Visit the Empire State Building for observatory views over Manhattan.
plans.plan_location: Empire State Building, Midtown, New York
plans.plan_details: Take the subway to 34 St–Herald Sq or nearby and walk to the entrance.

plans.trip_plan: Explore Fifth Avenue shops and landmarks like the New York Public Library and Bryant Park.
plans.plan_location: Fifth Avenue and Bryant Park area, Midtown, New York
plans.plan_details: Walk from the Empire State Building north along Fifth Avenue.

plans.trip_plan: Have a classic New York slice and casual lunch at a well-known pizzeria.
plans.plan_location: Joe's Pizza, Greenwich Village, New York
plans.plan_details: Take the subway or taxi downtown to Greenwich Village.

plans.trip_plan: Visit the 9/11 Memorial & Museum and reflect at the memorial pools.
plans.plan_location: National September 11 Memorial & Museum, Financial District, New York
plans.plan_details: Ride the subway from Greenwich Village to World Trade Center area.

plans.trip_plan: Enjoy an Italian-American dinner in Little Italy and a short walk through nearby Chinatown.
plans.plan_details: Take the subway or walk north from the World Trade Center area to Little Italy and explore on foot after dinner.
